title: How much time does AI save at work? New Census Bureau data breaks it down.
facts: Approximately 55% of workers reported using artificial intelligence on the job according to US Census Bureau data.
About one-third of workers using AI on the job reported saving one to two hours per task.
Workers reported using AI on the job for writing, idea generation, research, and administrative tasks.
Some workers reported using AI on the job to write software code, for medical care, and for supply chain logistics.
The findings are based on a weekly national survey conducted by the United States Census Bureau.
One-quarter of employees using AI at work stated the tools save less than one hour per task.
Fifteen percent of workers using AI at work reported saving three hours per assignment.
An additional fifteen percent of workers using AI at work reported saving four hours per assignment.
Massachusetts Institute of Technology research indicates that AI adoption in manufacturing initially decreases productivity before yielding long-term gains.
Economists utilize the 'J-curve' model to describe productivity dips during initial technology adoption followed by exponential growth.
The weekly Census Bureau survey gathers data on employment, food and nutrition, and transportation.
Initial learning curves for artificial intelligence tools can temporarily add hours to employee task completion times.
The US Census Bureau measured worker time savings across individual assignments using AI tools.
The J-curve model demonstrates that resource investment in new technology precedes productivity increases.
Over half of surveyed US employees utilize workplace AI across various industries.
